full_judgment: Moyeenul Islam Chowdhury, J: This Civil Rule was issued calling upon the opposite-party to show cause as to why the delay of 284 days in filing the uivil revisional application should not be condoned under Section 5 of the Limitation Act, 1908 and/or such other or further order or orders passed as to this Court may seem fit and proper.
